opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion for hearing is denied. The judgment is affirmed. Achilli v. United States, ante, p. 373, decided May 27, 1957.

Mr. Justice Clark and Mr. Justice Harlan took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
